title: Wed 25 Nov · morning check
summary:
[b]Overnight:[/b] Australia October CPI 4.9% y/y vs 4.7% expected, trimmed mean 3.8% vs 3.6% (Aussie strength condition's data half met; RBA pushback pending); ECB's Sleijpen sees a December hike as likely; Brent +2.3% to $91.40 on Gulf tanker mines; S&P 500 −0.5%, VIX ~26; Fed December odds 97%. No published score changes; AUD crosses under watch (scenario AUD +4).
[b]Next:[/b] Wed 25 Nov US Q3 GDP (2nd) + October PCE 15:30, BoE Treasury Committee 16:15; Thu 26 Nov US Thanksgiving, French CMP (date not confirmed); Fri 27 Nov Tokyo CPI, NZ election result.

USD.note: December Fed hike 97%, January 66% (FedWatch via Reuters); S&P 500 −0.5%, Nasdaq −1.5%; GDP and core PCE at 15:30.

EUR.note: ECB's Sleijpen: a December hike is likely; OAT–Bund about 152bp (+2bp); no CMP step.

GBP.note: Carried from Greene (24 Nov); no new MPC voice; ~81bp of BoE hikes priced to end-2027; shadow +3 if R2 +1.

JPY.note: Carried: Monday risk-on condition; services PPI 4.2% y/y (medium tier); no MoF comment; USD/JPY ~159.3.

CHF.note: Strongest G10 on Tuesday (price only); VIX close ~26.4 between the 25 and 30 lines; no SNB item.

CAD.note: Brent +2.3% to $91.40 on Gulf tanker mines; one unverified report of higher BoC hike bets after Macklem.

AUD.note: CPI 4.9% vs 4.7%, trimmed mean 3.8% vs 3.6%: R3 +1 (raw 0.90, held at 0); +4 if the RBA backs it (R2 +1).

NZD.note: Carried: Q3 retail beat; no NZ item overnight; official election result Friday.

XAU.note: Gold −2.7% to ~$3,554 on Tuesday (price only); no ETF, central-bank or real-yield data; core PCE today.

pairs.hook: A hawkish ECB voice overnight, yet EURUSD's bearish tilt rolls into PCE day intact.
pairs.note:
